content.stem: (audio) What benefit do customers get if they bring their own bags?

choices.C: One point on their point card.

transcript.speaker: N
transcript.text: Dear customers, this is an announcement from Green Leaf Supermarket. To reduce plastic waste, we encourage you to bring your own shopping bags. Plastic bags at the checkout counter cost five yen each. Customers who bring their own bags will receive one point on their point card per visit. Thank you for helping us protect the environment.

content.rationale: They receive one point per visit.
